posts.name: Chris
posts.cooked: I was working on getting sales invoicing set up and running a simple test invoice but I can’t make any progress with it because it sends an error “El campo “tax_id” es obligatorio y debe ser un RFC válido”. I’ve managed to pinpoint this from other forum posts that there’s an issue with Mexico E Invoicing. I’m not receiving an error code so the system seems to working as designed. I don’t have any plans to operate in Mexico for quite a while so how do I remove this module or prevent it from stopping every transaction I intend to make?
